svg.title: Figure 1
svg.desc: Figure 1. Matched-minus-control spatial similarity of retrieval gaze (dataset r3, analysis rev 4, run 7). Spatial correspondence, not sequential replay. Panel A: Encoding gaze Encoding · enc_03 · beach-042 Displayed: image. 13 fixations in scanpath order; marker area shows duration. Panel B: Retrieval gaze Retrieval · ret_07 Displayed: blank + fixation cross. The remembered image was not shown. 12 fixations in scanpath order; marker area shows duration. Panel C: Density maps Query ret_07 P17 · σ 2° Matched enc_03 0.94 Highest of 19 controls · harbor-231 0.72 Matched 0.94 · highest of 19 controls harbor-231 0.72 · control mean B 0.32 · D +0.62 Magenta: fixation duration mass per cell, shared limits; lines: 50% and 90% mass. Panel D: Participant D by response n = 24 each bars: grand mean of participant means, equal weight Each pair of dots is one participant; per participant, 2–17 queries per group. Descriptive only: no intervals or tests. Panel E: Scale profile by response Each scale computed separately. Analysis rev 4 · run 7 (archive unbound) · data r3 · reporting “By retrieval response” (sha256:3a0e…5dd) · studio build eyes4s 0.1

g.desc: Participant plot of Participant D at 2°: each participant's mean D in 2 groups, lines join a participant's means, a tick marks each group's grand mean. One focus stop; arrow keys move to the nearest mark, Page Up and Page Down step in order, Enter selects, Escape clears the selection. Participants: 50 marks for 50 rows. Every row is drawn.

g.title: Panel E: Scale profile by response
Scale profile
g.desc: Scale profile of run 7: each group's grand mean D at 4 scales, bold, over each participant's mean D, faint. One focus stop; arrow keys move to the nearest mark, Page Up and Page Down step in order, Enter selects, Escape clears the selection. Scale profile: 32 marks for 104 rows. Every row is drawn.
